description: This PHP source file contains a test class 'CandidateAPITest' that extends endpoint integration test functionality. It includes methods to test the Candidate API endpoints such as create, getOne, getAll, delete, and update within the recruitment module of OrangeHRM. The class primarily sets up test cases, mocks services, and asserts correctness of API behaviors.
